description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Each entry includes 'name', 'type' (file/directory), and 'children' for directories. Files have no children array, while directories always have a children array (which may be empty), except at the last level when 'depth' limits the tree: those directories are not read and have no children array. The output is formatted with 2-space indentation for readability. Only works within allowed directories.

depth.description: How many levels to descend: 1 lists only the entries directly in path. Directories at the last level have no children array. Omit for the whole tree.

excludePatterns.description: Patterns for entries to leave out, with their contents, matched against each entry's path relative to path. A pattern with no '*' matches that name at any depth ('node_modules' leaves out every node_modules directory); a pattern with '*' is a glob matched as written, and one ending in '/**' also leaves out the directory it names.

path.description: The directory at the root of the tree. Absolute, or relative to an allowed directory; it must resolve inside the allowed directories.

name: directory_tree
title: Directory Tree
